adr.rationale: The third independent review closes BR-03 after validating the XT-014 RFC keys and wrong-key vector, but BR-04 finds that point decoding admits identity, low-order, and mixed-order keys, so ADR 0002 remains proposed.

architecture.rationale: The blocked third review changes no runtime architecture; architecture synchronization remains an integration-owner action after ADR acceptance.

roadmap.rationale: The P0 milestone remains open while BR-04 blocks ADR 0002 acceptance; roadmap synchronization belongs to the integration owner.
